summary: A handoff note in the messages stream is read only once its acknowledgment commits

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes; the work.progress claim an acknowledgment writes is unchanged.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes or triggers change.

rules.detail: Handoff rules are unchanged: only the current recipient may acknowledge the exact current note.

compatibility.detail: A stream-note acknowledgment's progress claim still cites the read's offset receipt; the read in the messages shard is recorded after the graph transaction commits, so an acknowledgment the step refuses leaves the note unread. Other members check only the replicated progress claim, as before. Nothing writes stream items yet (db break-up step 4a).
